body: drainQueue skips 409-conflict duplicates instead of jamming; appendQueue dedupes on write. New style-discovery step: on 2nd+ generation for a subject, one attempt to propose a genuinely new style via Gemini text model when the registry ran short, model can decline. 15 new tests. Commit 80011b7. Cleaned 4 stale duplicates from the live queue file; 2 non-duplicate 'racially ambiguous swimsuit model' items left in place pending founder direction.
title: Prompt-o-verse: self-healing queue + style discovery via Vertex AI
